name: Return to Narain
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I'm a goblin of my word, kid. Here's your 500 pound chicken.

What a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know...

<Dirge grumbles something unintelligible.>

Probably to sleep in it... Dirty gnomes...
narrative.objectives: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Narain mashes two fists into the huge chicken, stuffing his face full of Dirge's delicious delicacy.>

MMmmm... This is unbelievable! Best chicken I've ever had!

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 60, 27,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Never Ask Me About My Business
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: The Isle of Dread!
quests.objectiveText: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

quests.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
quests.objectiveText: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.

quests.name: Return to Narain
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
